reason: Client-only DSH web plugin that adds session deep-link copying and opens or focuses a session selected by a URL query parameter.

summaries.zh: 在DSH网页界面中复制当前会话的深层链接，并通过URL参数直接打开或定位指定会话。
summaries.en: A client-side DSH web plugin for copying deep links to the current session and opening or focusing a session specified by a URL parameter.

capabilities: Adds a conversation-header control to copy a deep link containing the current session identifier
Reads a session identifier from the URL query string
Navigates the web interface to focus the referenced session
Uses the browser clipboard for copying the link
